Types.Name: E_EntityAction
Types.Description: An action defines something that can be performed at an entity.

EnumValues.Name: None
EnumValues.Description: No action which can be performed

EnumValues.Name: CheckIn
EnumValues.Description: Can perform a check-in (is required at the very beginning)

EnumValues.Name: CheckOut
EnumValues.Description: Can perform a check-out (is required at the end)

EnumValues.Name: Parking
EnumValues.Description: Allows/Requires parking before beeing called to be served

EnumValues.Name: Authenticate
EnumValues.Description: Can perform authentication (is required to enter a yard)

EnumValues.Name: Weighing
EnumValues.Description: Can perform weighing-processes (may be required before and/or after loading or unloading)

Types.Name: Entity
Types.Description: An entity is a base-type for different types (terminal, parkplatz, waage, silo, kreuzung) and is specialized by the concrete type [attribute xsi:type]

Properties.Name: Costs_Seconds
Properties.Description: Cost in seconds for the usage of this entity

Properties.Name: Id
Properties.Description: Unique identification of the entity - may be used for referencing and identification

Properties.Name: Name
Properties.Description: The readable name of the entity which should be used for humans to identify the entity

Properties.Name: Description
Properties.Description: Optional: Some description for this specific entity.

Properties.Name: Actions
Properties.Description: The Actions that may be performed by this entity

Types.Name: Street
Types.Description: A road connects two entities using a direction (source and destination) and gives the information, at which costs (time in seconds) the road can be used. A road has no action defined (none), while roads always allow driving only

Properties.Name: ID_From
Properties.Description: ID of the entity the road starts

Properties.Name: ID_To
Properties.Description: ID of the entity the road ends
